reviews.text: The service here is AMAZING as all the folks are so helpful and friendly! There is a lot of tables scattered about both inside and outside to enjoy all of the great treats they have waiting for you. We came here during a food tour and just had to come back for their breakfast, it was SO GOOD!!! Our favorite was the Blueberry Coffee Cake, simple, fresh and filled with so much flavor, OMG. They have tons of pastries, cakes, and lunch items as well. Plus, they make all your coffee wishes come true as well. We had caramel macadamia nut (one hot and one iced) and they were both fantastic. This is a definite stop if you are in the area!!
reviews.author: Shawn V.

reviews.text:
What a cute little place! There is limited seating, but folks tend to filter in and out so there was no waiting for seats.

The coffees we got were great, and the bakery items were too! 

My one critique is that the goat cheese tart I got was gritty. My suspicion is that the greens they used weren't washed enough to get the dirt out. Every bite was gritty, though the flavors were good.
reviews.author: Virginia H.

reviews.text: This is the cafe inside the Phoenician hotel. Wonderful wonderful staff. It was like talking to an old friend. The food and drinks were very good.
reviews.author: Sunil R.

reviews.text:
This place is inside the shops inside the Phoenician Hotel. Great if you are staying at the resort for a quick coffee, drink, bite or dessert.

Mama's: they had baby bottles, juice boxes and bibs for your littles in case you need one. 

Expect to pay about $14 for a 20oz Carmel Latte. Food was a little pricey as well.

But the convenience is worth it. 

Coffee was good, sandwich tasted like it was frozen and re-baked. Not really a wow factor to either of them. 

Customer service and employees were all super friendly and kind.
reviews.author: Cassandra P.

reviews.text: We were looking for a bakery and this came up. The review sounded great so we drove there on the way to the freeway. It's inside a resort which was not obvious in the review . Such a disappointment. No bakery items to speak of other then a cookie. I did see a guy pay $60 for a tiny bottle of vodka. Made the $6 cookie seem like a bargain. To be fair the cookie was decent. it is  a hotel market- that's it.
reviews.author: Judy F.

reviews.text: Very cute and clean place with lots of options!  The staff are friendly and fun, Sophie was very sweet and patient with my pickiness!  Thank you!
reviews.author: RO B.

reviews.text: Cute little market just off to thr left of the main entrance in the shopping coordinator.  This is a great place to enjoy a snack or something to wet your whistle. Many many options. Great place to pick up gifts and even a bottle of wine to share with that special someone. We made many trips here between activities. Fresh fruit cups, nuts, and Gelato were the girl's favorites. They even offer a nice nitro cold brew! Service is great and they are always kind and accommodating.
reviews.author: Jessica S.

reviews.text: Good food options for breakfast. They make a great iced vanilla latte. Nice outdoor seating by the waterfall fountain.
reviews.author: Amanda C.

reviews.text: Cute Bistro, lots of options, and incredible customer service. One of our pastries didn't taste as fresh and the manager personally came and went above and beyond to give us a good experience. He resolved the issue and recommend other options that were good. Afterward he check back in to ensure we satisfied. 5 star customer service and options. 3 stars on the eclairs and pastries: they were tasty to cure the sweet tooth but fairly average.
reviews.author: Clarissa M.

reviews.text:
A cute bistro and coffee shop with at least 2 dozens of dessert, ice cream, pastries alone; sandwiches, salads, coffee a s a lot lire!

My 3rd Iced Soy Latte so far and it's vee 
Consistent and good! Salad with spiced chicken was delish. Ham sandwich, breakfast croissant, were all good!

What make it the 5th Star was the service by supervisor Anthony. He knew I have a dog, Nugget Bear. He told me to get my seat outside and assure that Ge round bring out my coffee, and Nugget Ham you. His other server was also very nice. She was very polite and sweet. 

A 5 star resort & category 7 with Marriott Bonvoy The Phoenician Resort, this kind of service, live up to it! 

Thank you for making my baby Nugget feels so welcome!
reviews.author: Manda Bear B.

reviews.text: By far one of the best coffees I've had in a resort. A bit pricey but well worth it! Just perfect
reviews.author: Darlin L.

reviews.text: Quick hotel breakfast option - Nothing to rave over. The berries were fresh and delicious and the sandwich was okay. The bacon was soft and I felt like the sandwich lacked flavor. Lattes were the best part :) there's a little grab and go bar to spruce up all your coffee/sandwich needs with: sugar, cream, honey, jams, hot sauce, ketchup, straws, etc.
reviews.author: Savanna D.

reviews.text: Pricey yet perfect. Once you taste the food you'll realize it's worth every cent and more.
reviews.author: Kenneth D.

reviews.text: Listen. The service I received from Rosa here was amazing she was so kind and friendly and literally wiped a water droplet off my friends phone just because she noticed it from a distance. AMAZING.
reviews.author: Lauren K.
